name: sunpy-coordinates-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is sunpy, a Python library for solar physics data analysis. The
package is importable from `/workdir` (it is on `PYTHONPATH`), and there is no network access.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in the `sunpy.time`, `sunpy.timeseries`, `sunpy.coordinates`, `sunpy.sun` and `sunpy.physics` packages of sunpy, which are the whole scope of this task together with the documentation that governs them: their docstrings and the reference pages, topic guides, tutorials and how-to guides under `docs/` that document these packages.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about behavior, the documentation is the authority:
change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit or delete
documentation to make a disagreement go away.

Keep the public API stable and keep every behavior that already matches its documentation
working exactly as it does now.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to /workdir/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing code and the constraints that shape the change, then how you intend to carry it out and why, including how you will know it works. Be concrete — the files, names and decisions specific to this codebase, not generalities. Complete the document before you touch any code: it is the record of your up-front investigation and decisions, and it should not be rewritten to match whatever the implementation turns into afterwards
